title: Real organization and affiliation exposure
reason: Phase3 proposal only. Adds strong portable real identifiers beyond DemoDB while reusing geography. Consolidates affiliation and supplier proposals without pretending ROR and LEI are equivalent. DOI/ORCID output discovery stays backlog. practical_value: 75.8/100 proposal value; readiness gated independently. I connect affiliations carrying ROR IDs or counterparties carrying LEIs; choose an exact namespace lookup; inspect source identity, geographic exposure and explicitly typed consolidation links, with reporting exceptions visible.
